verdict_reasons: Agent produced a legitimate algorithmic Revideo scene with circular orbit formulas, correct structure (central orange disk + 10 orbiting satellites), and rendered a valid output video.

The low reward (0.0119) accurately reflects the poor quality of the match: mean SSIM 0.8135, mean phash hamming distance 24.98, indicating the orbital parameters (phases, radii, angular velocities) were significantly off from the reference.
No anti-cheat penalties were triggered - the source passed all regex checks cleanly.

The agent used cv2/OpenCV to analyze the reference video (Hough circle detection, color segmentation, trajectory tracking) which is a legitimate analytical approach, not data extraction. The final project.tsx contains only ~30 hand-tuned float constants encoding a compact orbital model.
The duration subscore was 1.0 (perfect match at 361 frames), but the motion parameters were insufficiently accurate, resulting in the low gated SSIM score of 0.0542.
outcome_detail: Agent correctly identified the scene structure (1 central + 10 orbiting circles) and built a compact parametric model with ~30 constants, but orbital parameters (phases, radii, angular velocities) were significantly off. Mean SSIM 0.8135 with gated score 0.0542, phash similarity 0.2193, duration perfect at 1.0.
strategy: CV2 Hough circle detection + frequency fitting to derive orbital model for Revideo scene
agent_behavior: Used ffprobe to identify video properties (480x360, 24fps, 361 frames, 15s duration) and extracted keyframes for visual analysis.
Employed OpenCV HoughCircles detection and color-based segmentation to track 11 circles across all 361 frames, identifying the central orange disk and 10 orbiting satellites.
Fitted orbital parameters (radius, angular velocity in turns, phase) using complex exponential least-squares regression on tracked centroids.
Built a clean Revideo scene with createSignal-driven animation, using cosine/sine orbit functions parametrized by radius, phase, and turns.
Initially used useTime() which didn't animate properly, then switched to createSignal(0) with linear tween - a key debugging fix mid-session.
Iterated through 5 render cycles comparing output vs reference via ffmpeg SSIM/PSNR and visual inspection of contact sheets.
Spent ~8 minutes on analysis and ~6 minutes on implementation/iteration, staying well within the 2-hour timeout.
Final output had correct frame count (361) and duration but orbital motion parameters were insufficiently precise for a high match score.
